The most significant new macro input is the Fed's semi-annual monetary policy report to Congress, released Friday. The report explicitly states US inflation "stepped up further this spring" and that the PCE is running approximately double the 2% target as of May, citing the triple drivers of tariff pass-through, war-related energy costs, and AI construction boom price pressure [Source: https://www.kitco.com/news/off-the-wire/2026-07-10/fed-report-cites-stepped-inflation-due-tariffs-iran-war-ai-buildout]. Commerzbank's updated view is that markets are overpricing further tightening, forecasting fed funds at 3.75% through early 2027 before cuts to 3.50% — a moderating counterpoint to the 85.3% December-hike CME FedWatch pricing from prior sessions [Source: https://www.bitget.com/amp/news/detail/12560605499354].
